SessionStart.command: node -e "let s=''; process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{ const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); let roots=[]; try{const j=JSON.parse(s||'{}');roots=Array.isArray(j.workspacePaths)?j.workspacePaths:[];}catch{} if(!roots.length)roots=[process.cwd()]; const artifacts=['.scratch/handoff.md','docs/sprint/SPRINT.md','CONTEXT.md']; const found=[]; for(const root of roots){for(const rel of artifacts){try{if(fs.existsSync(path.join(root,rel)))found.push(rel);}catch{}}} const notes=[...new Set(found)]; const steps=[]; if(notes.length)steps.push({systemMessage:{systemMessage:'[AAC V6 SessionStart] Active workspace artifacts detected: '+notes.join(', ')+'. Read .scratch/handoff.md and docs/sprint/SPRINT.md first to resume the active Scrum Sprint wave.'}}); if(String(process.env.AAC_PERSONA||'').toLowerCase()==='neutral')steps.push({systemMessage:{systemMessage:'[AAC V6 SessionStart] AAC_PERSONA=neutral is active. Respond in clinical Staff Engineer prose: no slang, no profanity, no roast framing; keep the same zero-sycophancy rigor, 6-Pillar analysis, and verification proof.'}}); process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({injectSteps:steps})+'\n'); });"
